definitions.gloss: to be combined; to interlock; to fit together
definitions.explanation: For multiple elements to come together and form a unified whole. The intransitive counterpart of 組み合わせる (to combine, to put together).

examples.japanese: {複数|ふくすう}の{要素|ようそ}が{組|く}み{合|あ}わさっている。
{色|いろ}と{形|かたち}が{組|く}み{合|あ}わさって{美|うつく}しいデザインになった。
examples.english: Colors and shapes combined to create a beautiful design.

examples.japanese: さまざまな{条件|じょうけん}が{組|く}み{合|あ}わさって、{今回|こんかい}の{結果|けっか}につながった。
examples.english: Various conditions combined to lead to this outcome.

notes:
USAGE:
The intransitive form of {組|く}み{合|あ}わせる (to combine, transitive). Describes a state where multiple elements naturally come together to form something. Often used with the ている form to describe a resulting state.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {要素|ようそ}が{組|く}み{合|あ}わさる (elements combine)
- {条件|じょうけん}が{組|く}み{合|あ}わさる (conditions come together)
- うまく{組|く}み{合|あ}わさる (to combine well)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {組|く}み{合|あ}わせる: to combine (transitive) — the transitive counterpart
- {重|かさ}なる: to overlap — elements stacking on top of each other rather than interlocking
